policy.automatic_labeling: Provider labels and machine-readable boxes may be transformed only when their semantics map directly to a SahiTol class. Ambiguous chemistry, alloy, grade, or mixed-object labels are excluded or mapped to manual fallback; they are never guessed.
policy.split_rule: Group by original source, provider object/sequence, exact hash and perceptual-duplicate cluster before deterministic split. Augmentation is training-only.
